Hi Anita / Sam,

Thanks again for the candid conversation earlier — appreciate the transparency on the competitor anchor. Per our call, I attached a concise proposal (EdgeStride_Pricing_Proposal_v2.pdf) that lays out a phased SKU repack and a KPI-linked credit structure that lets EdgeStride get immediate unit-cost parity without us giving an open-ended concession. - Phase 1 (Pilot, 6 weeks): scoped pilot on 2 services (inference + embeddings), our dedicated pool, measured by latency and token efficiency.
- Phase 2 (Rollout): staggered SKU repack across production tiers with a blended discount schedule.
- Credits: one-time onboarding credit + monthly reconciliation credits that are released only if agreed KPIs are met (both quality and latency).

Anita — great questions, answered inline below and summarized in the attached proposal workbook.

1) KPI triggers (proposed):
- Latency: 99th percentile inference latency < 150ms for the pilot traffic profile (measured at our edge ingress).
- Token efficiency: average tokens consumed per request within 5% of baseline generation quality (we’ll use a shared eval set to validate quality).
- Availability: service-level uptime >= 99.5% for pilot traffic.

If all three are met for the pilot period we release: a one-time onboarding credit equal to 25% of the pilot month spend and a monthly reconciliation credit equal to up to 10% of monthly invoice for the first 3 months after rollout (scaled by KPI attainment). The mechanics are in the ROI worksheet.

2) Integration risk / runtime changes:
- No SDK changes required. We’ll provision a compatibility profile that maps EdgeStride routes to our staging model variants plus a prefilling strategy for the KV cache.
- Ops ask from your side: short-lived API key for pilot, sampling hook to export a 1% trace for quality evaluation, and a simple routing flag (no code changes to your model calls). We’ll handle all runtime-side kernel and batching tuning.

Proposed cadence:
- Week 0: Contract addendum + pilot scoping (mutual action plan attached).
- Weeks 1–6: Pilot + daily check-ins first week, then twice-weekly.
- Week 7: KPI reconciliation and credit issuance (if met).

I’ll schedule Monday 10:00 PT and invite Kar and Marcus to cover pricing math and runtime constraints.

Thanks,
Jordan
